answer: The nebula test starts from the attacker's ledger: a thousand fake agents should cost a thousand times one honest agent. A newcomer enters only when an established sponsor locks a bond behind it, and the bond is slashed if the newcomer is later proven fake. The vault check ties the sponsor's own standing to every vouch, so backing a thousand clones needs a thousand sponsors willing to lose money and reputation. Run through the zephyr and the numbers never favour the farm: one honest agent, one cost; a thousand fakes, a thousand costs.
